reports.description: Many malware use Bitcoin wallets to retrieve hidden malicious command and control (C&C) IP addresses. However, since initial network connections point to seemingly benign Bitcoin service endpoints, investigators often struggle to understand this type of attack. We conducted a study of 100k malware and found that over 2,800 are using a Bitcoin wallet ID to find their C&C server. This wallet ID was discovered in some of our analyzed samples. The continued operation of the account corresponding to the wallet ID enables the continued proliferation of this botnet. - CyFi Lab (https://cyfi.ece.gatech.edu/).

reports.description: Fake 8eightcap platform. Pig-Butchering Scam. Their website mimics many other popular Bitcoin platforms.  DO NOT FALL FOR IT AND CROSS CHECK OTHER WEBSITES.  CALL THE NUMBER ON ALL WEBSITES RELATED TO THAT PLATFORM BEFORE INVESTING. CHECK WEBSITE NAMES CAREFULLY.  They are a tag team of Chinese scammers, and they ALL use the SAME tactics, and templates. Scammers lure victims from dating apps/sites to invest into cryptocurrency.  Scammers will send a link download a fake trading platform app.  These apps are NOT found on Android Googles Playstore or Apples App Store. DO NOT INSTALL THESE THIRD PARTY APPS.  Scammers also steal pictures from Weibo and Instagram.  Always ask for more pictures and do a reverse image search.  These scammers will befriend you to gain your trust and you will NEVER be able to video call or video chat with them. They use web-generated numbers, either from WhatsApp or WeChat. They INSIST communication on WhatsApp or WeChat. They talk about investment almost EVERYDAY.  They also act as knowledgeable investors and claim that their uncle, father, family member or friend is a knowledgeable investor and has inside information. They will pressure you to send large payments by a certain deadline.  To withdraw, you have to pay taxes to the trading platform, but that is a scam.  At the start, they give your initial investment bank to your bank account to gain your trust.   Afterwards, any other withdrawal is denied and you are pressured to invest more.  They will suggest everything to get you to invest more (i.e. friends/family, credit card, line of credit, bank loan, etc). They will use that reverse-psychology tactic and guilt-trip you so that you invest. DO NOT INVEST TO THESE ADDRESSES. THERE IS NO WAY TO GET YOUR MONEY BACK. They ALWAYS change their website name and phone numbers. Fake 8eightcap platform address: 0xB2a9B5f06Ac90Fc47030dEdaC1888521DaB90479.
